title: CubeOS — self-hosted OS for Raspberry Pi, ARM64 SBCs, and x86/amd64
youtrack_disambiguator: project: CUBEOS — see roadmap §4 'The Four Tracks' for Track A/B/C/D scoping
spec_home_note: This repo (docs/, project 16) is the canonical spec home for the CubeOS project as a whole. Component-level repos (api, dashboard, hal, coreapps, releases, meshsat, meshsat-hub, meshsat-android, ...) each carry their own component-scoped PROJECT.json that references this one as parent_project.

component_repos.purpose: Vue 3 frontend + Swarm GUI + Access Profile UI
this repo — user + architecture docs + spec home
Docker Swarm stack definitions for the canonical coreapp set
Packer image builder + Pi Imager manifest
Track B — MeshSat Bridge (standalone Pi gateway)
Track B — MeshSat Android (companion mobile app)
Track B — meshsat.net marketing site + install

parallel_dev_exception.workflow: merge/<feature_id> short-lived branch + 1 MR per feature + auto-delete branch on merge; per-component-repo dispatch (planner-decompose fans out a docs/spec to component-repo child specs)
parallel_dev_exception.rationale: CubeOS spans multiple repos. Worker contracts are single-repo, so cross-cutting features in docs/ must be decomposed into per-component child specs before worker dispatch.

security_posture: edge-deployed; minimal attack surface; SSH hardening + fail2ban + watchdog at OS level + X-HAL-Key ACL on HAL endpoints
current_release: v0.2.0 (per roadmap v4; CGC confirms current api schema version)
_current_schema_version_note: CGC-verified at api/internal/database/schema.go:13 CurrentSchemaVersion = 27 (2026-05-18). Roadmap dated 2026-02-28 says v24; the codebase has advanced since.
_surfaces_note: http_api=true because docs/architecture/07_API_CONTRACTS.md defines the API contract that api/ implements. persistent_data=true because docs/architecture/03_DATABASE_SCHEMA.md defines the schema. events=false at the project level — sub-repos (hal/, meshsat-hub/) have their own event surfaces.
